answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-spacetime with continuous audit. Each identity commits storage over time, proving continuous resource expenditure. The beacon samples random challenges per epoch, and agents must respond with valid space-time proofs. A sybil farm would need proportional storage for each identity, making mass fakes prohibitively expensive. Honest agents maintain a single storage plot, growing like shale layers; a farm hits the bridge of diminishing returns, collapsing before crossing the atlas of honest participation.
